bagPolicy.summary: The venue operates a bag policy to ensure quick searches and minimize contact. Bags must be no larger than A4 size with a maximum of two compartments, and rucksacks are not permitted.
allowed: Bags no larger than A4 size (21cm x 30cm x 19cm) with a maximum of two compartments
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is available on the NEC site, and visitors should follow signs to their event's designated car park. Avoid parking in the Resorts World Birmingham car park.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in bp pulse Live's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: bp pulse LIVE offers a self-serve bar with 'tap and go' technology for quick drink purchases, eliminating traditional checkout lines. The venue features food and drink spots across the Forum and Arena Bowl, ensuring visitors are never far from refreshments.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by bp pulse Live, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in bp pulse Live's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at bp pulse Live. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at bp pulse Live. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
